thesis: The morning thesis is intact: the post-earnings uptrend holds (last 20.915 > SMA20 19.18 > SMA50 18.04 > SMA200 16.06) after the Q3 adj. Today's dip from the 21.20 52-week high to 20.915 on light volume (4.2M) is mild consolidation with no news driver, the start of the retrace the bear's overbought point called for, not a breakdown. Entry stays pullback-only in 20.40-20.80 (mid 20.60), with R/R 2.0 to the 23.4 measured-move target. At the current 20.915 the R/R is only about 1.45, so do not enter above the zone.
invalidation: Daily close below 19.20 or back under SMA20 (~19.18); no entry if price never retraces into 20.40-20.80, and do not chase above 21.20.
